text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data between users and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through passwords or two-factor verification. Input validation is another important step, because it checks the data users submit and blocks harmful content. Developers must also know common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can seriously damage a site. By following these basic security practices, developers can build safer applications and protect both their users and their data from online threats.
